protocol: Nested CV: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42, same splits as v1); inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Neural models: max 1000 epochs, early stopping (patience 50). Preprocessing v2: motion correction, Friston-24 regressors, FD scrubbing, high-variance confounds, Schaefer-100 and Schaefer-200.
